full_prompt_en: A square monochrome ink-and-pencil portrait shows an elderly man in a dramatic upward-facing profile against a field of dense crosshatched gray. His head rises from the lower left toward the upper right, leaving a broad pale wedge of background at the right. Dark, nearly black hair or a dark cap forms a broad irregular mass behind the bald upper forehead. The face is pale and sharply articulated: a large eye opens wide beneath a high wrinkled brow, the long nose thrusts toward the right, and the mouth tightens under a sparse moustache. Deep creases run around the eye, down the cheek, and toward the jaw. A short pointed white beard projects from the chin, its fine hairs drawn with light directional strokes. The ear sits low at the left edge of the face, separated from the shadow by a precise pale rim. Below, a dark collar and heavy black cloak or coat sweep across the lower half, their surface made from many overlapping strokes rather than a flat fill. Behind the figure, lines slant diagonally upward in gray bands, with darker hatched swirls toward the upper left. The drawing retains visible paper between strokes, so even its darkest passages have a textured, hand-worked quality. Light is represented by largely unmarked paper on the forehead, nose, cheek, and beard; shadow collects under the brow, along the neck, and in the garment. There are no color accents and no readable text. The strong contrast between exact facial lines and more restless surrounding hatching gives the head a tense, searching energy. The overall composition is compact and psychologically charged, using a severe black-and-white value range and upward diagonal to focus attention on the staring eye and angular profile.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色墨线与铅笔肖像描绘一位老人戏剧性仰起的侧脸，背后是密集交叉排线构成的灰色场。他的头从左下升向右上，使右侧留下宽阔浅色背景楔形。深色、近乎黑的头发或帽子在秃露的上额后方形成宽阔不规则色块。面庞浅而棱角清楚：一只大眼在高高皱起的眉下睁开，长鼻向右伸出，嘴在稀疏胡须下紧闭。深刻皱纹绕过眼睛、沿脸颊向下并通向下颌。下巴伸出一撮短而尖的白胡子，细发丝由浅色方向笔触描绘。耳朵位于脸左下部，一道准确的浅色边把它与阴影分开。下方，深领口和厚重黑披风或外套扫过下半部，表面由许多叠加笔划组成，并非平涂。人物身后，线条成片斜向右上，在左上方变为更深的排线旋流。即使最黑区域，笔触间也留有纸面，因此仍保留手工经营的肌理。光由额头、鼻、颊与胡须上的大块未画纸白表现；阴影聚在眉下、颈旁和衣物内。画中没有彩色强调或可读文字。准确脸部线条与周围更不安的排线之间的强烈对比，给头部一种紧张、探寻的力量。整体构图紧凑而富心理张力，以严厉黑白明度和向上斜线把注意集中于凝视的眼睛和折角侧脸。
style_prompt_en: This monochrome ink-and-pencil treatment uses dense crosshatching and visible paper white as its main tonal tools. Directional strokes sweep diagonally through broad shadow masses, while shorter precise lines describe the brightest focal contours and small structural creases. Black, warm gray, and off-white interact without any chromatic accent. Some edges are carved sharply by adjacent white space; others dissolve into layered strokes and smudged gray. Light is expressed by withholding marks on selected planes and increasing line density in recesses, giving volume a dry graphic texture. A strong upward diagonal moves through an otherwise compact arrangement. The overall effect is restless, high contrast, and psychologically intense, with the handmade line work always visible.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色墨线与铅笔处理以密集交叉排线和可见纸白作为主要明暗工具。有方向的线条斜扫宽阔暗色块，较短而准确的线刻画最亮焦点轮廓与细小结构褶痕。黑、暖灰和灰白互相作用，没有彩色强调。一些边缘由邻近留白锐利地刻出，另一些则消失于层层笔划和擦开的灰色中。光通过在选定平面上少画笔痕、在凹处加密线条表现，使体积带干爽的图形肌理。一道强烈向上斜线穿过原本紧凑的安排。整体效果不安、反差强、心理强度高，手工线条始终可见。
theme_en: An elderly man's dramatic upward profile in black ink
theme_zh: 黑墨线描中老人戏剧性仰望的侧脸
name: Felicien Rops
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
